title: Converts projects to use the `@nx/angular:library` executor or the `@angular/build:library` builder.
description: Converts a library or all libraries using one of the `@nx/angular:package`, `@nx/angular:ng-packagr-lite`, `@angular-devkit/build-angular:ng-packagr` and `@angular/build:ng-packagr` executors to use the `@nx/angular:library` executor or the `@angular/build:library` builder. If the converted target is using one of the `@nx/angular` executors, the `@nx/angular:library` executor will be used. Otherwise, the `@angular/build:library` builder will be used. The ng-packagr configuration moves to the target options and the library `package.json` `exports`.

project.description: Name of the Angular library project to convert. It has to contain a target using one of the `@nx/angular:package`, `@nx/angular:ng-packagr-lite`, `@angular-devkit/build-angular:ng-packagr` and `@angular/build:ng-packagr` executors. If not specified, all projects with such targets will be converted.
